# wowsims links (2 November 2026)

The final set of each spec of the second run (enchants and consumables), with the Retribution raid buffs and debuffs, a level 63 boss and 2 min. Open a link, then select Simulate. The sim of this commit gives these DPS values: a later wowsims version can give a different DPS.

| Spec | DPS (895cd67f9) | Link |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fury Warrior | 901.6 | [Open in wowsims](https://wowsims.github.io/forever/warrior/dps/#) |
| Combat Rogue | 685.2 | [Open in wowsims](https://wowsims.github.io/forever/rogue/dps/#) |
| Hunter | 828.7 | [Open in wowsims](https://wowsims.github.io/forever/hunter/dps/#) |
| Fire Mage | 916.1 | [Open in wowsims](https://wowsims.github.io/forever/mage/dps/#) |
| Demonology Warlock | 919.3 | [Open in wowsims](https://wowsims.github.io/forever/warlock/dps/#) |
| Retribution | 921.1 | [Open in wowsims](https://wowsims.github.io/forever/paladin/retribution/#) |

`zzlink_main.go` makes these links (copy to `cmd/zzlink/main.go`). It also decodes each link and runs it again as a check.
